rules: BNB location is assessed on ORIGINAL signal candle, not later intrabar entry. Width is its unchanged EMA(high-low,50).
Known price levels: previous completed UTC day high/low, strict hourly pivot highs/lows with 2 hours each side; retain120h from confirmation. Level must be known at signal candle open.
Long: nearest known level below close, distance >0 and <=1W, signal low <=support+0.25W. Short mirrored. Missing levels reject entry. No room, momentum, trend or efficiency filter added.

A rejected opposite entry MUST still close the old position. Passing signal arms existing next2-bar body-break order; do not require another location touch later. No stop reentry, repeated entries or delayed reverse exit.
SOL/BTC native periods and all parameters unchanged. Only confirmation_level3, max_wait_bars2 and execution5m/protection5m are added. Residual same5m ambiguity stays stop_first.
Dates unchanged; full current equity compounding, no fees/slippage/leverage. Fine-data execution is part of requested combined upgrade; no causal claim separating the two changes.
Preserve requests, baseline metrics, strategy and engine snapshots, hashes, trades, equity and logs. Compare native candle data before attributing differences to strategy.
